findings.reason: Verified: GroupPermissionsV2.canManage() calls hasPermission(null, VIEW, MANAGE), which resolves to the Groups type resource and returns true for a VIEW-only all-groups grant, and addTopLevelGroup (GroupsResource.java:181) gates on requireManage(), so a view-only admin can create top-level groups.

Verified: per-group resources are created without setType (AdminPermissionsSchema.java:121), so findByType("Groups") only returns the all-groups type resource, and the set holds resource UUIDs rather than group names, so per-group grants are missed and an all-groups grant injects a bogus ID into UserModel.GROUPS, which breaks counts and list results.

Verified the listener is registered under the V1 flag while management() returns MgmtPermissionsV2 when V2 is on, and V2's setPermissionsEnabled throws, so deleting a group fails if both flags are enabled; nothing in Profile forbids that combination, but it is an unusual preview/experimental setup and the finding is phrased as a question.
Correct but trivial: the requireManageMembers javadoc names canManageMembership while GroupPermissions.java:377 checks canManageMembers, a docs-only inaccuracy.

The tests indeed rely on per-user canView and never assert users().count(), which exercises the broken getGroupIdsWithViewPermission path, so the gap is real but it is a secondary test-gap on top of finding 1's defect.
